faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Why hire an interior designer for office space in Hauz Khas?

Many Hauz Khas offices are in converted buildings or upper floors with odd layouts. A designer makes the most of the space while keeping it comfortable for the team.

Can you design creative studios and agencies?

Yes. Studios need open work areas, quiet corners, display walls and good natural light, and we plan the space around how your team collaborates.

How do you handle wiring and networking?

Power, data and lighting points are planned with the furniture layout, so cables stay hidden and workstations can be moved later if needed.

What does an interior designer for office projects deliver?

Layouts, 3D views, furniture and finish selections, drawings for contractors and site supervision until the office is ready to use.
